name: pi-deepseek-pet-workspace
description: Pi DeepSeek Pet desktop application and Pi lifecycle extension
author: SchneeHertz

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pi-deepseek-pet/protocol build && pnpm --filter @pi-deepseek-pet/core build && pnpm --filter pi-deepseek-pet-extension build && pnpm --filter pi-deepseek-pet-desktop build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.package:extension: pnpm build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && pnpm --filter pi-deepseek-pet-extension pack --pack-destination artifacts
